meta.description: Curriculum-aligned practice bank with coding, debugging, design, testing, workflow, interview scenarios and the existing LeetCode catalogue.
meta.note: Workbook v7 lists 2,089 questions. Only those present in the supplied export are included; the rest are added when the full workbook is imported.

questions.title: Trace Git staging
questions.prompt: Create a repo with three files. Change two files, stage only one, run status and diff commands, then explain exactly what each area contains.
questions.acceptanceCriteria: Show working tree, index and HEAD states before and after each command.
questions.hint: Use git status --short, git diff and git diff --cached.
questions.how: Attempt independently first. Write down assumptions, test normal and edge cases, then explain your reasoning and trade-offs.

questions.title: Recover from a mistaken commit
questions.prompt: Make a commit with an incorrect message, then correct it safely. Repeat with an accidental file included and explain when amend, restore and reset are appropriate.
questions.acceptanceCriteria: Preserve intended changes; explain the difference between undoing local and shared history.
questions.hint: Inspect git status and git log before changing history.
questions.how: Attempt independently first. Write down assumptions, test normal and edge cases, then explain your reasoning and trade-offs.

questions.title: Resolve a realistic merge conflict

questions.hint: Use git diff and inspect both branch versions before editing.
questions.how: Attempt independently first. Write down assumptions, test normal and edge cases, then explain your reasoning and trade-offs.
